name: Wang Chia
bio: Wang Chia is dated by Giles to the 9th century AD. His poem here is on a spring storm.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: A Storm
poems.author: Wang Chia
poems.text:
No rain, and lovely flowers bloom around;
Rain falls, and battered petals strew the ground.
The bees and butterflies flit, one and all,
To seek the spring beyond my neighbour's wall.

poems.title: 春晴 (Chun qing)
poems.author: Wang Chia
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
雨前初見花間蕊，雨後全無葉底花。
蜂蝶紛紛過牆去，卻疑春色在鄰家。
